name: Tademaru Kazuki
source:
Sonogi’s personal secretary. The son of a prominent opposition party lawmaker, he once aspired to be a politician himself. After meeting Sonogi and recognizing his potential, he decided to support him as his secretary.
Skipped a year of college in the U.S., where he polished his academics, language skills, and personal network.
Because he joined the ruling party alongside Sonogi, his father disowned him. While some within the ruling party are suspicious of an opposition lawmaker’s son serving a ruling party politician, the arrangement has ironically boosted his popularity among the public.
Never without his phone.

[Translated from [url=https://holicworks.net/24ku/mainchara.html]the official website[/url].]
